privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.dataCollectedBody: We collect the information you voluntarily provide: name, phone, email, address and files sent when ordering or requesting a quote.
privacyPage.dataUseBody: This data is used solely to process your orders, quotes and contact requests, and to keep you informed of their progress.
privacyPage.dataSharingBody: Your data is never sold. It may be shared with our delivery or payment providers, solely to fulfill your order.
privacyPage.dataStorageBody: Data is kept for as long as necessary to process your order and meet our legal obligations.
privacyPage.rightsBody: You may request access, correction or deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.objectBody: These terms govern any order placed on the DadPrint platform.
termsPage.ordersBody: Any order is confirmed after quote validation and receipt of the files needed for printing.
termsPage.pricingBody: Prices are shown in MRU. Some products are quoted based on the options chosen.
termsPage.paymentBody: Payment is made via one of the methods available on the platform (Bankily, Masrivi, Sedad, Click, BIM Bank, Amanty).
termsPage.deliveryBody: Delivery is offered throughout Mauritania; studio pickup remains available at any time.
termsPage.designBody: Any graphic design produced by DadPrint remains subject to customer approval before printing.
termsPage.liabilityBody: DadPrint cannot be held liable for errors in a file provided by the customer and approved by them before printing.
